speaker: Doctor
text: Can you please tell me exactly where the pain is located and whether it has moved to your right lower abdomen? Also, have you experienced any fever, nausea, or vomiting since the onset of pain?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Mesenteric Ischemia (Acute Bowel Ischemia)

I suspect this is due to ischemia given your recent heart attack and the "pain out of proportion" pattern; please confirm if you have noticed a decrease in bowel sounds or if your abdomen feels rigid upon touch. REQUEST TEST: Lactate_Level, Complete_Blood_Count, CT_Angiography_Abdomen. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_CTA.
